additional_concerns: Preservation of an existing application's processing procedure does not expressly establish permanent substantive ineligibility for relief. The legacy exclusions are proposed interpretations, not settled consequences of the quoted transition.

The introductory immediate-effect wording and the express 28 November 2025 commencement provision require reconciliation. The latter supplies a specific date, but the source does not establish a universal implementation-date test.
Moving commencement or legacy status between scope and result changes OUT_OF_SCOPE versus FALSE outcomes. These candidates answer different typed questions and are not interchangeable.
The supplied dependency catalogue gives no mapping from its two missing IDs to named authorities. Neither ID can safely be assigned to the FAQs or forms.

Home compliance and feature classifications remain supplied judgments. Actual application requires applicable home-jurisdiction requirements and, where necessary, SFC guidance on novelty, complexity and possible local policy implications.

Removal of prior approval does not settle notification, filing, post-vetting or overall compliance. No separate home-supervision condition should be inferred merely from the introductory purpose statement.
